# CanvasCraft

> CanvasCraft is a free, browser-based interactive whiteboard for sketching, visual brainstorming and diagramming. It runs entirely in the browser with no sign-up; boards are saved to the browser's local storage.

Built with React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4 and the HTML5 2D Canvas API. It is a single-page app, so the whole product lives at one URL.

## Try it

- [CanvasCraft web app](https://canvascraftsb.netlify.app/): open the whiteboard and start drawing.

## Features

- Tools: pencil, rectangle, circle, line, arrow, text, sticky notes and an eraser.
- Multiple selection: Shift+click, marquee drag, or Ctrl/Cmd+A; group move, resize, rotate, recolor, layer and delete.
- Infinite workspace with cursor-centered wheel zoom, pinch zoom and hand panning.
- Undo and redo (up to 100 steps) and automatic local saving.
- Light and dark themes with theme-aware stroke colors.
- Export dialog: PNG, SVG or copy to clipboard, with background, dark-mode and 1x/2x/3x scale options.
- Keyboard shortcuts for every tool (V, H, R, C, A, L, P, T, S, E).
